description.value: Twin City Brewing Company is an award-winning craft brewery and full-service taproom in Port Alberni, crafting a rotating roster of beers—from West Coast IPAs and German pilsners to fruit sours—entirely on-site. The kitchen turns out scratch-made food including hand-stretched pizza, smoked meat sandwiches, tacos, and rice bowls, making it a genuine meal stop rather than just a tasting room. Positioned in the Alberni Valley as part of Port Alberni's emerging tourism and recreation identity, it serves as a lively community hub for both locals and visitors exploring Vancouver Island.
